Description: WhatsApp Business Cloud API integration for Umbraco — backoffice inbox with the 24-hour customer-service window, contact management, approved-template and free-form sending, and an inbound webhook receiver. Umbraco 13 (net8.0) and 17 (net10.0); the Lit 3 dashboard requires Umbraco 17.

AuthorDetails.Name: SplatDev
AuthorDetails.Description: SplatDev Ltda — building Umbraco plugins and tools for agencies and developers.

Screenshots.Caption: Inbox — conversations with initials avatars, readable numbers, delivery ticks, and how long the 24-hour reply window has left.
Contacts — names your team gives WhatsApp numbers, used across the inbox in place of the WhatsApp profile name.
Send an approved template with its variables filled in, previewed before it goes out.
Every template on your WhatsApp Business Account, with approval status and variable count.
Phone health, quality rating, and setup warnings for anything left unconfigured.
